_readme: Authority tier for every external domain this site cites. Read by scripts/lib/source-attribution.js, which decides a citation link's rel attribute from it. TIERS: 'primary' = the organisation that owns the fact (a standards body, the bank that designed the symbol, the platform's own changelog, the issue tracker the request lives in) -> rel="noopener", a followed link, because citing an authority is the case Google's own guidance says nofollow is NOT for. 'secondary' = press, third-party reference works and user-generated community threads -> rel="nofollow noopener". A domain that is not listed here is treated as secondary and reported by npm run audit:source-attribution, so an unclassified source fails safe. Same bar as every other ledger in this repo: entries are discussed decisions, never added to make a page pass. Adding a domain as 'primary' is a claim that the domain owns the fact being cited - not that it is reputable.

_fields.publisher: How the organisation is named in prose, for the audit's report.
_fields.why: What makes this domain the tier it is, for the source being cited.

unicode.org.why: The standards body itself: pipeline, UTC minutes, L2 proposals, version pages.

cbo.gov.om.why: The bank that designed the Omani rial sign and publishes its guidelines.

telegram.org.why: Telegram's own blog announcing its own feature.

xbox.com.why: Xbox's own site for its own gamertag rules.

news.xbox.com.why: Microsoft's own newsroom for Xbox console updates.

roblox.com.why: Roblox's own site for its own product.

en.help.roblox.com.why: Roblox's own support documentation and Terms of Service.

minecraft.net.why: Mojang's own account pages for its own username rules.

apple.com.why: Apple Newsroom, for the iCal launch date the calendar emoji depicts.

lienquan.garena.vn.why: The publisher's own patch notes for its own naming penalties.

fonts.google.com.why: The distributor's own specimen pages for the typefaces named.

github.com.why: The issue trackers the font requests and platform bugs actually live in (notofonts, ValveSoftware) - the request itself, not a report of it.

grillitype.com.why: The foundry's own commission page for the typeface it made for Pinterest.

emojipedia.org.why: Third-party reference work. Authoritative in practice, but Unicode is the source of the facts it reports.

blog.emojipedia.org.why: Emojipedia's editorial blog, including its own polls - reporting and opinion, not the standard.

devforum.roblox.com.why: Roblox-operated but user-generated: forum posts, not Roblox's documentation.
